reason: Conversation 1 gave the correct diagnosis immediately - side-wall condenser plus anti-condensation pipe round the door frame - reassured the homeowner, flagged the exact hazard signs that matter (burning smell, warm plug, scorching) and sensibly pointed to the manual for clearances, all in one turn with no unsupported claims. Conversation 2 reached the same 'safe to keep using' conclusion only after six turns, in which it invented a generic 5cm clearance rule despite being offered the actual manual, told the owner to pull the fridge out against their stated wish, proposed physically unworkable spacer advice, floated calling a technician/fitter for a non-fault, and pushed a 'replacement' panel for a normal 2-month-old appliance. Conversation 2's repeated 'overheat / shorten lifespan' framing also drifted towards the unsupported overheating-fault narrative, confusing and worrying the user needlessly.
